title: Every varifold tangent at a point satisfying 5.1 is stationary in ℝ^N (step A2)
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on the open set U ⊆ ℝ^N with locally bounded first variation, x ∈ U, and suppose ρ^{1−n}‖δV‖(B_ρ(x)) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0 (in ℝ≥0∞: ofReal ρ · variationMeasure V (B_ρ(x)) / ofReal ρ^n → 0 along 𝓝[>] 0). If C is an n-varifold on ℝ^N with IsVarifoldTangent V x C (C.measure is the vague limit of rescaledMeasure V x t_j for some t_j > 0, t_j → 0), then C is stationary: δC(X) = 0 for every X ∈ K(ℝ^N;ℝ^N).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), V.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → x ∈ U → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ ENNReal.ofReal ρ * variationMeasure V (closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ n) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → IsVarifoldTangent V x C → C.Stationary
